headers.comment: Stylesheet and script filenames are NOT content-hashed, so they must never be cached immutably: a returning visitor would keep the old build for a year and never receive a design or copy update. max-age=0 with revalidation is cheap here, because ETags turn repeat requests into 304s and Vercel's CDN still serves them from the edge.
Images change rarely. A week of caching with a background refresh is safe; if an image must change immediately, rename the file and update the reference.
